judgment.rationale: Both are Class-1 Content bullets (rank 0, same coordinate) drawn from the same table row under Competency C-1.4 'Observes, identifies, and extends basic patterns in everyday surroundings'. Their Learning Components are parallel triples (observe / identify / extend patterns) applied to two different perceptual attributes: colour versus lines and dots. This is substantive conceptual coherence in pattern recognition across complementary attribute contexts, mutually reinforcing rather than sequential: neither bullet adds complexity, broadening, or combination over the other, and no source evidence orders colour patterns before line/dot patterns. Same-rank developmental direction therefore lacks substantive support, so the symmetric relation is chosen. Source evidence for both endpoints is truncated (24 omitted items each), but the retained bullet text and LCs are sufficient for this judgment; absence of further ordering cues in the excerpt is not proof of absence in the full source.
